temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been keeping something from Christian and says he is in some trouble.

temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan was hiding something important and is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To find out what Jonathan is hiding and uncover the truth.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, is reluctant to drag Christian in, but admits he could use support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan was hiding something important and is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Jonathan’s trouble is complicated, and he needs support/resources.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but claims he did not do anything illegal himself.

temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate discreetly without alarming Jonathan and ensure his safety.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian’s investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; someone is trying to set him up.

temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person; Jonathan is innocent or being set up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather evidence to prove Jonathan’s innocence and clear his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian finds out the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan, someone they both know and trust.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person; Christian is gathering evidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Christian now identifies the real culprit as a trusted person close to both of them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The real culprit is someone close to both Christian and Jonathan; that person betrayed them and may be dangerous.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
